model.title: Built-in local model
model.body: Optional download. Q-One accepts only the pinned revision and checksum and serves inference on a loopback address.
model.notInstalled: The local model is not installed
model.notInstalledHelp: Rule recommendations are fully available. After download, Q-One can try to produce a more concrete first step and finish line.
model.readyHelp: The model loads on demand. The first response may take a while; rule suggestions remain available if it fails.
model.requirements: At least 4 GB of available memory is recommended. No account is needed, and the installer does not contain the model.
model.onboardingTitle: Would you like more specific suggestions?
model.onboardingBody: Optionally download Qwen3 0.6B. Goals, actions, feedback, backup, and restore all work without it.
model.onboardingReady: The local model is ready. You can finish setup.
model.onboardingDownloaded: Download complete. The model will load on demand after you enter Q-One.
model.serviceUnavailable: The model service is not active. Suggestions will continue with rule drafts.
onboarding.title: Start with one action thread that belongs to you.
onboarding.intro: No server and no account. After four short steps, Q-One can start working on this device.
onboarding.privacy: Goals, records, and reviews stay on this device by default.
onboarding.languageBody: This changes the interface and new rule suggestions. You can change it later.
onboarding.goalTitle: What would you like to move forward?
onboarding.goalBody: Name a verifiable finish line. Q-One will begin with one small, concrete action rather than inventing a grand plan.
onboarding.goalPlaceholder: Example: Build and present a small Python project within four weeks
onboarding.criterionPlaceholder: Example: The project runs locally and demonstrates the complete flow
onboarding.backupTitle: Leave your data a recoverable path.
onboarding.backupBody: Automatic backup writes AES-256-GCM encrypted files to a folder you choose. You keep the recovery key.
onboarding.browserBackup: Browser mode cannot use the desktop operating-system key store. Install the desktop app to enable automatic encrypted backup.
onboarding.desktopOnly: You can continue using Q-One now. All records remain in the current local data directory.
today.title: Do one thing today that moves something forward.
today.subtitle: Suggestions come from your goals and recorded facts. You make the final decision.
today.quote: A record is not a burden. It makes the next choice less of a guess.
today.schedule: What you have agreed to do
today.noTasks: Nothing is scheduled for today yet. Start with one small item.
today.goalFirstBody: Write one goal and a verifiable finish line. Q-One can then suggest where to begin.
today.noRecommendation: You do not need to force another action right now.
today.noRecommendationBody: A goal exists, but no new suggestion fits the current time budget. Refresh or add your own commitment.
today.firstGoalTitle: A goal need not be grand, but its finish line must be visible.
today.firstGoalBody: You can edit, pause, or complete a goal at any time. Q-One does not turn unfinished work into failure.
today.refreshing: Requested an update to today's suggestions
recommendation.confirm: Accepting creates one task. It does not execute anything or prove that an outcome happened.
recommendation.dismissed: This suggestion is hidden for today
goal.criterionLabel: How will you know it is complete?
goal.newTitle: Write a goal with a visible finish line
goal.saved: Goal saved. Suggestions will use the new information
goals.title: A goal is not a checklist item. It is a direction you choose to fund.
goals.subtitle: Every goal keeps its success criterion and current state. Editing a goal does not erase what already happened.
goals.empty: No goals yet. Start with one direction you are willing to begin.
task.name: Action
review.title: Review what happened, not the worth of the person.
review.subtitle: Keep outcomes, unknowns, and the next small step separate. Missing data does not become a conclusion.
review.promptTitle: Four questions for a clearer next step.
review.question1: Which choice met the criterion written in advance?
review.question2: Which judgment still lacks evidence, and which measure needs revision?
review.question3: What is the one small thing to change next?
review.interpretation: Adoption is not recommendation accuracy. Outcomes with no record remain unknown.
review.empty: Your first review can begin with one concrete thing that happened today.
settings.title: Let Q-One fit your pace, not the other way around.
settings.subtitle: Every setting stays on this device. No account and no telemetry by default.
settings.dailyMinutesHelp: Suggested actions never exceed this budget.
settings.autoRecommendHelp: Recheck when goals or records change. Nothing is executed automatically.
settings.rulesReadyHelp: You can complete goals, actions, feedback, and reviews without a network or local model.
settings.workingData: The working database remains plain SQLite protected by operating-system account permissions. Encryption applies only to .qonebackup files.
settings.supportHelp: Preview local versions, backend status, and recent error events. Goals, actions, review text, backup paths, and secrets are excluded.
support.desktopOnly: Support packages can be exported only from the desktop app.
support.previewBody: Confirm the preview contains nothing you want to keep private before saving and sending it.
update.title: Keep Q-One current
update.body: Updates come only from a signed manifest and are checked again before install.
update.checkingHelp: Fetching the signed manifest and update metadata.
update.availableHelp: The download runs in the background and is checked again before install.
update.downloadHelp: Install becomes available only after a complete download. A failure leaves this version unchanged.
update.readyHelp: Install will quit Q-One and reopen it after the update.
update.upToDate: This version is up to date
update.upToDateHelp: No newer signed release was found.
update.unavailable: Automatic updates are not enabled in this build
update.notConfigured: This build has no release public key. Update checks stay off and unsigned content is never downloaded.
update.manualOnly: The Linux deb build requires a manual package download and install.
update.error: The update could not be completed. Try again later.
update.security: Goals, records, and keys are not uploaded. Only signed manifests and verified artifacts are accepted.
backup.desktopOnly: Automatic encrypted backup is available only in the desktop app.
backup.confirmFirst: Confirm that you saved the recovery key first
backup.confirmSaved: I saved the recovery key and understand that the backup cannot be recovered without it
backup.encryptionNote: Recovery requires the key you saved. Q-One does not write it to logs or ordinary data exports.
backup.keyMissing: The backup key is missing from the operating-system key store. Automatic backup is paused.
backup.keyUnavailable: No recovery key is available to copy
backup.manualOnly: This system cannot persist an automatic-backup key securely. You can still create a manual backup and save its recovery key yourself.
backup.noKeyWarning: Without the recovery key, no device can open this backup.
backup.reuseKeyConfirm: Confirm the recovery key in the operating-system key store was saved, then enable automatic backup?
backup.restoreBody: This backup was created {date}. Q-One will ask for replacement confirmation and keep a safety copy of current data.
backup.saveKeyBody: Write down or copy this key and store it somewhere trustworthy, separate from this computer.
backup.scanQr: Scan the QR code with another device, or write down the recovery key below.
backup.sessionOnly: This system's key backend cannot persist secrets securely. Automatic backup is blocked so a restart cannot leave an unrecoverable configuration.
error.title: The local service needs attention
error.REQUEST_FAILED: The request did not complete. Try again.
error.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The local service is unavailable. Reopen Q-One.
error.DESKTOP_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED: The local connection expired. Reopen Q-One.
error.DESKTOP_CONTROL_REQUIRED: This operation must come from the desktop app. Reopen Q-One.
error.DATABASE_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED: This data came from a newer Q-One release. Install the newer app.
error.LEDGER_CORRUPT: The local record integrity check failed. Inspect a backup first.
error.RECORD_NOT_FOUND: That record no longer exists. Refresh and try again.
error.REQUEST_VALIDATION_FAILED: Some submitted fields are missing or invalid.
error.INVALID_REQUEST: The submitted content cannot be saved. Check the fields.
error.INVALID_FIELD_TYPE: A submitted field has the wrong type.
error.ORIGIN_REJECTED: The request origin is not accepted. Use the Q-One window.
error.CLIENT_HEADER_REQUIRED: The desktop client marker is missing. Reopen Q-One.
error.REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: The submitted content is too large.
error.CONFLICT: The data changed. Refresh and try again.
error.MODEL_PROVIDER_FAILED: The model service is unavailable. Rule suggestions are still available.
error.MODEL_DOWNLOAD_NETWORK_ERROR: The model download connection was interrupted. Try again later; downloaded bytes are kept.
error.MODEL_DOWNLOAD_CANCELLED: The model download was cancelled. Rule recommendations are unaffected.
error.MODEL_DOWNLOAD_FAILED: The model download failed. Check your connection and try again; rules remain available.
error.MODEL_DOWNLOAD_HTTP_ERROR: The model server could not complete the download. Try again later.
error.MODEL_DOWNLOAD_EMPTY: The model server returned no file content. Try again later.
error.MODEL_DOWNLOAD_WRITE_FAILED: Writing the model file was interrupted. Check free disk space and try again.
error.MODEL_RESUME_RANGE_INVALID: The model resume range was invalid. The download was stopped and can start over.
error.MODEL_FILE_CORRUPT: The model file is incomplete or has the wrong checksum. Download it again.
error.MODEL_HASH_MISMATCH: The model checksum did not match. The downloaded bytes were discarded.
error.MODEL_SIZE_MISMATCH: The model size did not match the pinned manifest. The downloaded bytes were discarded.
error.MODEL_HOST_NOT_ALLOWED: The model download redirected to an unapproved host and was stopped.
error.MODEL_URL_INVALID: The model download address is invalid.
error.MODEL_REDIRECT_INVALID: The model download redirect had no valid target and was stopped.
error.MODEL_REDIRECT_LIMIT: The model download redirected too many times and was stopped.
error.MODEL_MANIFEST_INVALID: The pinned model manifest is invalid. The download was stopped.
error.LOCAL_MODEL_SERVICE_FAILED: The local model service did not start. Rule recommendations remain available.
error.LOCAL_MODEL_SERVICE_EXITED: The local model service exited. Rule recommendations remain available.
error.LOCAL_MODEL_TIMEOUT: The local model took too long to start. Rule recommendations remain available.
error.LOCAL_MODEL_PROCESS_ERROR: The local model process encountered a problem. Rule recommendations remain available.
error.LOCAL_MODEL_PROCESS_EXITED: The local model process exited. Rule recommendations remain available.
error.LOCAL_MODEL_FILE_MISSING: The local model file is missing. Download it again.
error.LOCAL_MODEL_CANCELLED: The local model request was cancelled. Rule recommendations remain available.
error.LOCAL_MODEL_INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY: There is not enough memory for local inference. Rule recommendations remain available.
error.LOCAL_MODEL_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE: This device could not load the local inference runtime. Rule recommendations remain available.
error.BACKUP_INVALID_OR_WRONG_KEY: The recovery key is wrong or the backup is damaged.
error.UPDATE_NOT_CONFIGURED: This build has no trusted update public key, so automatic updates are off.
error.UPDATE_NETWORK: The update server cannot be reached right now. Try again later.
error.UPDATE_MANIFEST_INVALID: The update manifest is invalid or failed signature verification. The update was stopped.
error.UPDATE_METADATA_MISMATCH: Update metadata does not match the signed manifest. The update was stopped.
error.UPDATE_VERSION_MISMATCH: The update version does not match the signed manifest. The update was stopped.
error.UPDATE_DOWNLOAD_FAILED: The update download did not complete. The current version is unchanged.
error.UPDATE_ARTIFACT_MISMATCH: The update file failed verification, so nothing was installed.
error.UPDATE_UNAVAILABLE: Automatic updates are unavailable in this environment.
error.UPDATE_FAILED: The update could not be completed. Try again later.
